quarterly_data.quarter: Feirongda investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: it keeps close cooperation with leading brand terminal makers; its products for smartphones mainly include graphite sheets, graphene, heat pipes, VC, phase-change energy-storage materials, micro fans and micro-pump liquid cooling, plus EMI shielding materials and devices. It said AI is pushing smartphones toward more diverse forms, technology upgrades and higher per-device usage, raising the performance and demand requirements for thermal management and EMI shielding; product categories and prices differ by customer and model. Asked about Cisco, it said it has cooperated with that customer for many years and supplies it EMI shielding and thermal-management products, and would not disclose cooperation details, citing customer requirements and confidentiality.
